title: Arterial
summary: ARTE'RIAL, adjective [See Artery.] 1. Pertaining to an artery or the arteries; as arterial action. 2. Contained in an artery; as arterial blood.

inlines.v: ARTE'RIAL, adjective [See Artery.] 1. Pertaining to an artery or the arteries; as arterial action. 2. Contained in an artery; as arterial blood.
